instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the launched Archicad graphical user interface. Do not open Terminal, Command Prompt, or PowerShell; do not run Python, shell, IfcOpenShell, Archicad API, scripts, macros, or any helper automation that directly generates or edits the deliverable file. Use only Archicad native GUI tools, menus, dialogs, palettes, element settings, and built-in save/export commands. Workshop Addition. Start from the provided init.ifc by opening it in Archicad. The init model is a relevant but incomplete predecessor; clean, complete, rename, subdivide, or add BIM elements as requested instead of replacing it with unrelated geometry. Build or edit the model using real Archicad BIM elements: Walls, Slabs, Zones, Doors, Windows, Roofs, Stairs, Columns, Beams, or Curtain Walls where required. Do not use visual-only Morphs, objects, meshes, or generic proxy placeholders as substitutes for the required BIM elements. Save the only required deliverable on the Desktop as C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc using Archicad's built-in IFC export or Save As IFC workflow. Export the complete model as IFC and include the Zones/Spaces in the export. IFC2X3 or IFC4 export is acceptable. Start from the provided office/store model. Add or complete a WORKSHOP Zone as part of the same one-storey building, with real walls, slab, roof, doors, and windows. The final Zones must be OFFICE, STORE, and WORKSHOP. The exported IFC must contain exactly 3 Zones exported as IfcSpace entries named OFFICE, STORE, WORKSHOP. It must contain exactly 1 building storey; at least 8 wall-like IfcWall or IfcWallStandardCase elements; at least 1 IfcSlab element; at least 1 IfcRoof element; at least 3 IfcDoor elements; at least 3 IfcWindow elements. The shaped model should have an overall size roughly matching X span 14 m, Y span 8 m, and Z span 3.8 m. Keep the model simple enough to complete manually in Archicad: rectangular or orthogonal rooms, ordinary straight walls, standard door/window tools, simple slab and roof elements, and only the listed structural or glazed elements where requested. The IFC should have unique GlobalId values for IfcRoot objects and should not contain IfcBuildingElementProxy objects as substitutes for required spaces, walls, slabs, roofs, stairs, doors, windows, columns, beams, or curtain walls. Other exact coordinates, room proportions, wall thicknesses, opening positions, materials, library part names, property sets, layers, relationship nesting, and harmless exporter metadata may vary as long as the saved result.ifc satisfies the stated BIM content and approximate overall size.
